text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(The cheers aren't as loud as the ones I
heard
during that race I saw on TV back
home, but
there's still a ton of people
here for my debut
race.)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone who ran was so talented...
They really
gave it their all. Some of
them are even crying!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (The Twinkle Series is... It's just so...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Fun!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That's Matikanetannhauser, right? She
seems
kinda different from the others
somehow!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon made her debut just
the other
day, and she was also really
good. I think she's
aiming for the Triple
Crown or something!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? I don't know if
Matikanetannhauser
is going on the
Triple Crown tour, but I sure hope
so!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Boy, I can't wait for their classic year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A faint sense of expectation is growing
among the
spectators, who can sense
Matikanetannhauser's
potential.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Debut complete!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
This might seem a bit soon, but there's
something
I'd like to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well... I can't stop wondering why the
director
had such high expectations for
me even before
my debut.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Why an ordinary Umamusume like me? I
just can't
figure it out...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But for her to come out and say it again
like that
makes me think there must be
some reason
behind it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to start off by taking
on every
challenge I can during my
classic year!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And on that note, the first thing on the
menu is
winning the Classic Triple
Crown!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And of course I know it'll be tough! That
much is
obvious!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The fastest racer wins the Satsuki Sho,
the
luckiest wins the Japanese Derby,
and the
strongest wins the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
They're all renowned G1 races you can
only
compete in once in your lifetime,
which of course
attracts all the most
passionate Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But even still, I want those crowns!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a super cool, super
glamorous Triple
Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, no doubt about it. Even if it's
not gonna
be easy, I know what I want.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So! Trainer! What do you think?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she understands how tough
it'll be,
and as her trainer it's my duty to
support her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yesss! Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, let's kick things
off with a
training journey!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I sort of mentioned it before, but it'd be

impossible for me to win the Triple
Crown right
now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So I need to blast myself up to a level
where I
can! One bullet train ticket to
Triple Crown town!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
To be more specific... I want to get good
enough
to place in the top five at a G1
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wheeze, wheeze... Puff!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Phew. Geez, it's bright out here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I guess Tannhauser's debut race is
probably
over by now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All right! One more lap!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooh, Nature's firing on all cylinders!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Well, just the other day she was
going on
about how Teio hasn't given up
on the Kikuka
Sho despite her fracture.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our first objective is to place in a G1
race. I want
our preparation to be on
point so that we have a
chance at the
Triple Crown next year!
